d: We are seeking a qualified and experienced Registered Nurse - ICU to provide safe, compassionate, and evidence-based nursing care to critically ill patients. The successful candidate will monitor patients closely, administer medications and treatments, assist with critical care procedures, and work collaboratively with physicians and the multidisciplinary team.
Provide comprehensive nursing care to critically ill patients in the ICU.
Assess, monitor, and document patients' vital signs, neurological status, and overall clinical condition.
Identify changes in patients' conditions and promptly escalate concerns to the treating physician.
Administer medications, IV therapies, blood products, and other prescribed treatments safely.
Manage and monitor patients requiring ventilatory and other advanced life-support interventions.
Assist physicians with procedures such as central line insertion, intubation, arterial line placement, and other critical care procedures.
Operate and monitor ICU equipment, including ventilators, infusion pumps, cardiac monitors, and other life-support devices.
Respond promptly to medical emergencies and participate in resuscitation and code blue situations.
Maintain accurate and timely nursing documentation and patient records.
Implement infection prevention and control measures in accordance with hospital policies.
Provide appropriate patient and family education and emotional support.
Collaborate effectively with physicians, respiratory therapists, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals.
Ensure safe medication administration and compliance with medication safety procedures.
Participate in handovers, multidisciplinary rounds, and care planning.
Maintain patient safety, confidentiality, and professional nursing standards.
Participate in quality improvement, clinical audits, and continuing professional development activities.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent.
Valid DHA license or DHA eligibility as a Registered Nurse.
ACLS certification is required or preferred, depending on facility requirements.
Additional critical care certifications/training are an advantage.
Minimum 2–3 years of clinical nursing experience, preferably in an ICU or Critical Care Unit.
Proven experience caring for critically ill and mechanically ventilated patients.
Experience with cardiac monitoring, infusion pumps, ventilators, and other critical care equipment.
Experience in emergency response and resuscitation procedures.
Previous experience in a hospital or tertiary-care setting is preferred.
Strong clinical assessment and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent patient monitoring and emergency-response skills.
Good knowledge of critical care nursing practices.
Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

r: The Service Project Manager is responsible for the execution of service orders for the compression fleet in the assigned country. This position plans, organizes, monitors, drives processes and resources to achieve order and project objectives within scope, time, quality, and budget. The Service Order Manager is also responsible for managing and monitoring the backlog of service orders, managing customer contact during execution and representing Compression Service to clients whenever needed, driving revenue growth, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

Responsible for the execution of compression service orders (Parts, Repairs, Field Service – and any combinations – LTPs, Mods&Ups) in backlog, between PM 80 and PM 700 including complete outage projects.

Customer management for orders under execution, being the voice of the customer in the organization, while improving customer contact for all service offerings within the region, including regular, proactive, and/or early communication in case of any issues.

Organize teams, ensure individual responsibilities, develop project/program schedules, and determine resource needs according to specific challenges. Coordinates internal teams (Technical Support, Engineering, Product Competency Centers, Sales, etc.) to clarify technical requests from the customer and resolve delivery concerns.

Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of service business deliverables. Achieve revenue, EBIT, on-time delivery (OTD) and project delivery as per budget/schedule targets and drive client's satisfaction while managing claims and support cash collection targets. Drives NPS results related to execution.

Assists the finance team with accurate forecasting of deliveries to ensure revenue and cash collection targets are met. Responsible for aligning and coordinating the execution of service orders together with the PCC Parts Execution team in the region and the global PM organization based on each of the Compression factories around the world.
Reporting status or progress to internal stakeholders/management with appropriate details. Preparing and submitting project progress report to customers as per contractual requirements.

Collaborate with GS and STG project managers (e.g., for full train outages, LTPs) and implement necessary measures to maximize opportunities and mitigate risks, including early issue communication to internal and external customers. Coordinate with Field Service (FS) organization globally and with the regional FS teams to ensure proper outage planning and staffing, and timely delivery of reports.
